0022600154.text: Boston enters as 4-1 with a four-game winning streak, sitting 2nd in the Atlantic and 3rd in the East, and it is 4-0 at home but 0-1 on the road. Orlando is 2-3 and 9th in the East, and it has yet to win at home this season; it is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), while Devin Carter (illness) is out for Boston. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Boston won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 113-108 win in Boston on April 12, 2026.
